class GSLFunction(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("function", ctypes.c_void_p),
                ("params", ctypes.c_void_p)]

# Define CQuadWorkspace structure
class CQuadWorkspace(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("n", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("ivals", ctypes.c_void_p),
                ("heap", ctypes.c_void_p)]

# Define function prototypes
gsl.gsl_integration_cquad_workspace_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_integration_cquad_workspace_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(CQuadWorkspace)

gsl.gsl_integration_cquad_workspace_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(CQuadWorkspace)]

gsl.gsl_integration_cquad.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLFunction), ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(CQuadWorkspace), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t)]
gsl.gsl_integration_cquad.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Callback type for user function
FUNC_TYPE = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_void_p)

def integrate_function(func, a, b, epsabs, epsrel, workspace_size):
    # Create callback wrapper
    def my_func(x, params):
        return func(x)
    
    # Create callback function
    c_func = FUNC_TYPE(my_func)
    
    # Create GSLFunction structure
    gsl_func = GSLFunction()
    gsl_func.function = ctypes.cast(c_func, ctypes.c_void_p)
    gsl_func.params = None
    
    # Allocate workspace
    workspace = gsl.gsl_integration_cquad_workspace_alloc(workspace_size)
    if not workspace:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate workspace")
    
    # Prepare output variables
    result = ctypes.c_double()
    abserr = ctypes.c_double()
    nevals = ctypes.c_size_t()
    
    # Perform integration
    status = gsl.gsl_integration_cquad(ctypes.byref(gsl_func), a, b, epsabs, epsrel, workspace, ctypes.byref(result), ctypes.byref(abserr), ctypes.byref(nevals))
    
    # Free workspace
    gsl.gsl_integration_cquad_workspace_free(workspace)
    
    # Check for errors
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Integration failed with error code {status}")
    
    return result.value, abserr.value, nevals.value

    # Perform QR decomposition

    for i in range(rows):
        for j in range(cols):

def compute_moving_median(data, window_size):
    # Load required libraries
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    
    # Define GSL median accumulator structure and functions
    class gsl_rstat_quantile_workspace(ctypes.Structure):
        pass
    
    gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rstat_quantile_workspace)
    gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
    
    gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rstat_quantile_workspace)]
    
    gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_reset.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rstat_quantile_workspace)]
    
    gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_add.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rstat_quantile_workspace)]
    
    gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rstat_quantile_workspace)]
    gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_get.restype = ctypes.c_double
    
    # Initialize median accumulator
    workspace = gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_alloc(0.5)
    
    medians = []
    n = len(data)
    
    for i in range(n):
        # Add current data point
        gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_add(data[i], workspace)
        
        # If we've filled the window, remove the oldest point
        if i >= window_size:
            # Reset and re-add all points except the oldest
            gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_reset(workspace)
            for j in range(i - window_size + 1, i + 1):
                gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_add(data[j], workspace)
        
        # Get median if window is filled
        if i >= window_size - 1:
            median = gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_get(workspace)
            medians.append(median)
    
    # Clean up
    gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_free(workspace)
    
    return medians

        gsl.gsl_vector_free(eval_vec)

        gsl.gsl_eigen_hermv_free(workspace)

                ("tda", ctypes.c_size_t),

    _fields_ = [("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("stride", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
                ("block", ctypes.c_void_p),
                ("owner", ctypes.c_int)]

def numpy_to_gsl_matrix(np_array):
    if not np_array.flags['C_CONTIGUOUS']:
        np_array = np.ascontiguousarray(np_array)
    matrix = gsl_matrix()
    matrix.size1, matrix.size2 = np_array.shape
    matrix.tda = matrix.size2
    matrix.data = np_array.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
    matrix.owner = 0
    return matrix

    vector = gsl_vector()
    vector.size = np_array.size
    vector.stride = 1
    vector.data = np_array.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
    vector.owner = 0

    gsl.gsl_rng_set.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_ulong]
    gsl.gsl_vector_alloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    gsl.gsl_vector_get.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl.gsl_vector_get.restype = ctypes.c_double
    gsl.gsl_vector_set.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]
    
    # Allocate RNG
    rng = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc(gsl.gsl_rng_default)
    gsl.gsl_rng_set(rng, 0)
    
    # Allocate vector
    vec = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(N)
    
    # Generate vector with varying sigma
    current_sigma = sigma[0]
    sigma_idx = 0
    for i in range(N):
        if sigma_idx < len(N_sigma) and i >= N_sigma[sigma_idx]:
            sigma_idx += 1
            current_sigma = sigma[sigma_idx]
        val = gsl.gsl_ran_gaussian(rng, current_sigma)
        gsl.gsl_vector_set(vec, i, val)
    
    # Allocate workspace
    work = gsl.gsl_sort_workspace_alloc(N)
    
    # Compute and print statistics

    for i in range(N):

        window_size = end - start
        
        # Extract window
        window = (ctypes.c_double * window_size)()
        for j in range(start, end):
            window[j-start] = gsl.gsl_vector_get(vec, j)
        
        # Sort window

        # Compute statistics

    # Free memory

    class GSLPermutation(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
                    ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t))]

def cholesky_decomposition(input_matrix):
    # Load libraries
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    
    # Define types
    class gsl_matrix(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [("size1", ctypes.c_size_t), ("size2", ctypes.c_size_t), ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))]
    
    class gsl_permutation(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [("size", ctypes.c_size_t), ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t))]
    
    # Define function signatures
    gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix)
    gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    
    gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)
    gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
    
    gsl.gsl_matrix_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_matrix_get.restype = ctypes.c_double
    gsl.gsl_matrix_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    
    gsl.gsl_permutation_get.restype = ctypes.c_size_t
    gsl.gsl_permutation_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation), ctypes.c_size_t]
    
    gsl.gsl_linalg_pcholesky_decomp.restype = ctypes.c_int
    gsl.gsl_linalg_pcholesky_decomp.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)]
    
    n = len(input_matrix)
    
    # Allocate and initialize matrix
    matrix_ptr = gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc(n, n)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            gsl.gsl_matrix_set(matrix_ptr, i, j, input_matrix[i][j])
    
    # Allocate permutation
    perm_ptr = gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc(n)
    
    # Perform decomposition
    result = gsl.gsl_linalg_pcholesky_decomp(matrix_ptr, perm_ptr)
    
    if result != 0:
        raise ValueError("Decomposition failed")
    
    # Extract results
    decomposed_matrix = []
    for i in range(n):
        row = []
        for j in range(n):
            row.append(gsl.gsl_matrix_get(matrix_ptr, i, j))
        decomposed_matrix.append(row)
    
    permutation = []
    for i in range(n):
        permutation.append(gsl.gsl_permutation_get(perm_ptr, i))
    
    return (decomposed_matrix, permutation)
